chunks.text: Based on general Formula 1 knowledge rather than live race data, the Silver Arrows have a legendary history—from Juan Manuel Fangio's titles in 1954 and 1955 to winning eight consecutive Constructors' Championships from 2014 to 2021 in the turbo-hybrid era!

Drawing on general F1 knowledge, Mercedes has a legendary history, from the dominant Silver Arrows of the 1950s with Juan Manuel Fangio to an unprecedented era of eight consecutive Constructors Championships between 2014 and 2021. This modern championship run redefined excellence in the sport, cementing the team's place as one of the greatest dynasties in motorsport history.
